findings.detail: The EUR symbol on the Saffron Bidco term-loan row belongs to Par/Shares, not Fair Value; fair_value_currency should remain USD/reporting currency.
The GBP symbol on the Saffron Bidco delayed-draw row belongs to Par/Shares, not Fair Value; fair_value_currency should remain USD/reporting currency.

rationale: FX02 is a real data error. The flagged observed values are U_EUR and U_GBP in fair_value_currency, but the raw SOI table header separates Par/Shares from Cost and Fair Value. In table 17, rows 4 and 5 show EUR/GBP symbols only in the Par/Shares area for Saffron Bidco continuation rows, while the Cost and Fair Value cells are subsequent valuation columns. The parser appears to have carried the local par currency into fair_value_currency.
